name: the frame gate no longer lets a record page run in the right frame
why: bs-record runs in the frameset's wide right-hand frame `principale` (vzell: 'Own tab + right frame'). Without the exemption the frame gate stops it there like the list frame.

name: the frame gate lets a record page run in a frame of any name
why: Only `principale` is the site's record frame; another frame (another site's iframe) stays out.

name: vinyl sides are not paired into records
why: All Those Years' 10 LP writes sides 1-20 as groups; vzell's answer: 'Pair sides when it adds up'. Without the pairing it shows 20 'Side' sub-tables.

name: N groups are not N records
why: The River's 2 LP writes one group per record (1/1-1/11, 2/1-2/9). Without this branch its sub-tables are named by side.

name: a repeated medium name gets no " (2)"
why: Only a site numbering that repeats a group after another one (1, 2, 1) gives two equal names; no snapshot shows one, so no spec can see this guard. Kept so two sub-tables never share one name (the grouped render keys groups by name).

name: a ditto row starts a show of its own
why: The From cell writes a double quote for 'same as above'. Without carrying the row above's show, a ditto row has no date, show, country or show page.

name: the show index '/1' is not stripped before the split
why: The From text ends in the show's index of the day ('02-May-1999/1'). Without it in the pattern, nothing splits: Date and Country stay empty and Show is the whole text.

name: script links keep their "#"
why: The page's song and show links are href='#' script links. Without a real page they preview nothing, and '#' is the record page itself.
grep: the script links given their pages

name: a script link carries the site's &hecan=1
why: Every link to one page is one cache key: the hecan flag changes nothing a reader reads and is left out.
grep: the script links given their pages

name: helps('000000000') becomes a link
why: '000000000' is the site's 'no show' (its own helps() opens nothing). No snapshot has one in a row, so no spec can see this guard; the reader would ask a page that does not exist.
grep: the script links given their pages

name: showdisc() links are not given their record page
why: A show page's 'Found on' records are showdisc() links. Without them the section has no records and the window cannot open one.

name: a missing photo counts as one
why: The site hides a missing photo with onerror: a photo exists only if it loads. Without the load check a 404 shows a broken tile.

name: the site's record block stays visible under the view
why: The head and the tables show all of the record; the site's own block hides once the view is built.

name: the Notes paragraph is taken from anywhere in the page
why:
A copy of the live page may hold other markup before the record (the harness's inline userscript holds a '

Notes:' in a comment). Only the Notes after the facts are the record's.

name: the line between the facts and the Notes is lost
why: All Those Years' LP writes 'The original version is numbered.' outside the Notes paragraph; the reader dropped it before parser version 17.

name: *PROMO* stays in the title
why: The site writes the promo flag into the title; it becomes the Promo fact and the title is kept without it.

name: every record is a bootleg
why: The page's title says Discography (official) or Bootlegs: the subheader's kind.

name: Sources counts a show once per track
why: Sources lists every show once, its tracks counted together (29 shows on All Those Years' LP, one of them met twice).

name: a song page is read as a record
why: _dpParseBs() hands a song page (sd3.aspx) to _dpParseBsSong(); a record parse finds no 'Title :' line there.

name: a show page is read as a record
why: _dpParseBs() hands a show page (mn.aspx) to _dpParseBsShow().

name: song links are no detail links
why: The preview takes a link only when isDetailUrl admits it: without sd3.aspx no song card.

name: show links are no detail links
why: Without mn.aspx in isDetailUrl no show card.

name: "[Released version]" stays in the titles
why: An album release writes every line as 'Version 99 - Song [Released version]'; the remark says nothing there.

name: the show window's sections do not fold
why: The show record is collapsible, so 'Found on' is a section of its own (details.mb-dp-sec) like the song's versions.

name: Load from Disk gives the record page no table
why: A disk load runs the converter on the live page too: the site's block hides and an empty table goes under our h2.
